basis: Reka HoverCardContent renders an unroled container (verified in the reka-ui dist); the trigger is the slotted control's own semantics.

interaction.basis: a revealed surface around content — the hover intent is its own act, nothing operates inside.

exceptions.because: the card's content is read-only by design — Reka strips tabindex off every tabbable node inside, so Tab never enters it; the contract to witness in a browser is trigger focus opening the card, blur closing it, Escape dismissing it, and Tab crossing from the trigger past the card without entering or trapping; no component-owned harness spec witnesses those gestures yet; that floor is ecoma-io/loom#432's tranche work
